question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

I was going to mention it, but it ________.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. **'slipped my mind.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"slipped my mind" **is appropriate for the blank because it accurately conveys the idea of forgetting to mention something.
 
• **Slipped my mind:** means to forget something or to fail to remember it (भूल जाना).
 
 
• **Example: **I was going to call you yesterday, but it completely slipped my mind.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "I was going to mention it, but it **slipped my mind**__."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Brought to mind (याद दिलाया): **Means to cause someone to remember or think of something.
 
• **Changed my mind (मन बदल लिया): **Indicates deciding differently than before or altering one's decision or opinion.
 
• **Bore in mind (मन में रखा): **Means to keep something in mind or not to forget it.
